verdict.rationale: VLP's Employment page describes an employment practice advising startups and growing businesses on employment law and HR issues. Its Executive Compensation page covers drafting incentive plans, which supports a documented employment practice in general terms. However, the pack never names the specific hiring documents in the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; detail on the employment-document workflow; independent corroboration.
